title: potentilla drummondii var. breweri
intro: Potentilla drummondii var. breweri, commonly known as Drummond's cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Drummond's cinquefoil include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla drummondii var. breweri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
